channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: DR Congo Ebola outbreak spreads to a sixth province
item.description: Ebola outbreak has killed 2,128 people out of around 4,566 recorded cases in the DRC, according to government figures.

item.title: Reports of US sailors in Middle East trying to jump ship spark outcry
item.description: US senators call for inquiry as USS Lincoln has record-long period without port stop amid war on Iran.

item.title: Is Russia’s economy cracking despite the Iran war windfall?
item.description: A widening deficit and Ukrainian strikes are testing Russia's economy, even as war in the Middle East lifts oil revenue.

item.title: Will all-out war in Yemen reignite as the Houthis escalate attacks?
item.description: Analysts say Saudi Arabia is strengthening its position with regional allies as the Houthis increase their attacks.

item.title: Iran says Strait of Hormuz under its control, rejects Trump claims
item.description: Iran asserts full control over the Strait of Hormuz, challenging US claims of dominance in the strategic waterway.

item.title: Falling Danube flow forces shutdown of Romania’s sole nuclear plant
item.description: Romania had tried to avert a total shutdown of the plant, which usually generates a fifth of the country's electricity.

item.title: Palestinians told to leave homes in village where Israeli settlers besieged houses
item.description: The mayor of Qusra says Israeli troops have been telling families to leave their houses, using some as barracks.

item.title: Romania shuts only nuclear plant as heat causes huge drop in Danube River level
item.description: The Cernavodă plant, which produces 20% of Romania's electricity, is not expected to be restarted within the next 10 days.

item.title: Ebola outbreak on track to be deadliest ever, WHO chief says
item.description: The outbreak, declared on 15 May, has caused more than 2,000 deaths, with thousands more reported cases.

item.title: Israeli settlers besieging Palestinian families in West Bank village
item.description: Israeli security forces have reportedly withdrawn and about a dozen settlers are said to remain at the site where two families have been besieged since Sunday.
